motiq.hero_subheadline: MotIQ fuses electrical, thermal, and operational intelligence into one industrial device, so hidden faults surface weeks before failure.
motiq.positioning_one_liner: Electrical. Thermal. Operational. Insight in one device.

core_features.title: Electrical Intelligence
core_features.short_description: Three-phase current, voltage, power, and harmonics in real time.
core_features.long_description: MotIQ continuously analyses three-phase motor currents with voltage reference, capturing power factor, active and reactive power, frequency stability, and harmonic distortion. Current Signature Analysis reveals rotor bar breakage, eccentricity, and slip-frequency anomalies that conventional protection never trips on.
core_features.icon_concept: Three phase-shifted sine waves overlaid with a subtle dashed mean line

core_features.title: Thermal Awareness
core_features.short_description: An on-board 8×8 infrared array watches contactors for hidden hotspots.
core_features.long_description: An integrated infrared camera renders a live thermal map of the contactor and connection zone. High-resistance joints, oxidation, and loose terminations are identified long before they smoke, a class of failure traditional monitoring never sees at all.
core_features.icon_concept: A 3×3 grid of squares with the center cell highlighted as a hotspot

core_features.title: Health Score
core_features.short_description: One number that reconciles electrical, thermal, and operational signals.
core_features.long_description: MotIQ synthesises every stream into a single health percentage engineers can act on. Condition trends, confidence levels, and advisory states let teams distinguish an early-developing pattern from a fault that needs action this shift.
core_features.icon_concept: A clean progress ring three-quarters full with a subtle tick mark

core_features.title: Predictive Alarms
core_features.short_description: Detect looseness, eccentricity, and misalignment weeks early.
core_features.long_description: Advanced signal analysis and pattern recognition watch for subtle mechanical signatures riding on the electrical waveform. Predictive alarms flag emerging conditions; active alarms elevate stronger fault evidence, so nothing is missed and no one overreacts.
core_features.icon_concept: An ascending line with a small diamond marker one-third before its peak

core_features.title: Seamless Integration
core_features.short_description: Modbus RTU, BACnet/IP, and BMS-ready out of the box.
core_features.long_description: Every MotIQ transmits processed health indicators, not raw telemetry floods, to your existing BMS, SCADA, or PLC. Industrial protocols come standard; the 800×480 LCD gives operators local clarity the moment they walk up to the panel.
core_features.icon_concept: Three concentric half-arcs indicating signal propagating outward

core_features.title: Motor Control
core_features.short_description: Start, stop, and automate right from the panel.
core_features.long_description: The Premier tier adds manual start/stop/auto controls and remote dry-contact operation, with protection and safety logic built in. One device for diagnostics and command means fewer cabinets, fewer wires, and one source of truth.
core_features.icon_concept: A minimal play/pause triangle nested inside a square frame

sections.headline: Intelligent motor health, made visible.

eht.hero_headline: Plan a repair. Avoid a crisis.
eht.hero_subheadline: Unplanned equipment failures can cost up to 40× more than the same repair done on a schedule. EHT gives your team the early warning window to act before a fault becomes an emergency.
eht.hero_eyebrow: Equipment Health Tracker · Intelligent Condition Monitoring
eht.positioning_one_liner: Vibration. Acoustic. Temperature. Intelligence in one compact sensor.

core_features.title: Triaxial Vibration
core_features.short_description: Three-axis accelerometer captures imbalance, misalignment, and looseness in full 3D.
core_features.long_description: EHT's MEMS accelerometer measures vibration simultaneously across X, Y, and Z axes, mounted directly on the bearing housing where faults originate. Continuous frequency analysis detects imbalance, misalignment, looseness, and resonance signatures that broad-band threshold monitors routinely miss.
core_features.icon_concept: Three orthogonal axes with overlapping waveforms on each

core_features.title: Acoustic Analysis
core_features.short_description: High-frequency microphone detects bearing noise and cavitation invisible to vibration alone.
core_features.long_description: Ultrasonic and high-frequency acoustic signals reveal bearing surface defects, cavitation in pumps, and early gear mesh anomalies, often weeks before they escalate to measurable vibration increases. When sound and vibration are analysed together, fault detection confidence increases dramatically.
core_features.icon_concept: Radiating arcs from a central point, frequency-labeled

core_features.title: Temperature Trending
core_features.short_description: Thermal profile tracking correlated with vibration and sound over time.
core_features.long_description: Rising temperature at the bearing housing, combined with concurrent changes in vibration and acoustic signals, is a reliable composite indicator of a developing fault. EHT tracks all three signals together, looking for correlated deviations from the asset's learned normal signature.
core_features.icon_concept: A gradual upward curve with a threshold line and early detection marker

core_features.title: On-Device ML
core_features.short_description: Pattern recognition runs locally on the sensor, no cloud dependency.
core_features.long_description: EHT's machine learning models run directly on the sensor hardware. After a commissioning period, the device learns each asset's unique operating signature and flags meaningful deviations. No specialist required, no raw data to interpret, just processed health status your BMS can act on.
core_features.icon_concept: A node graph converging into a single output indicator

core_features.title: BMS Integration
core_features.short_description: Processed health status to your BMS via Modbus RTU or BACnet/IP.
core_features.long_description: EHT does not flood your network with raw sensor readings. It sends processed diagnostic results, health index, fault type, severity, directly to your building management system. Maintenance teams see clear, actionable status without needing vibration analysis expertise on site.
core_features.icon_concept: Three concentric half-arcs indicating signal propagating outward

core_features.title: Compact & Wireless
core_features.short_description: Mounts on the bearing housing in minutes. No cabling to the panel.
core_features.long_description: The EHT sensor's stainless steel body mounts directly on the machine, no penetrations, no control panel wiring. Wireless transmission means retrofitting existing equipment is quick and non-invasive. Industrial-grade enclosure designed for real facility environments.
core_features.icon_concept: A minimal cylindrical form with signal rings radiating from the top

sections.headline: Making hidden machine behavior visible.
sections.body_short: One sensor. Vibration, sound, and temperature, fused by on-device ML.
sections.body_long: EHT is a compact condition monitoring sensor that bolts directly onto rotating equipment and delivers actionable maintenance intelligence to your BMS.
sections.animation_cue: Sensor model fades in, rotates once, settles at three-quarter angle.

sections.headline: 3 Sensors. One Device.
sections.body_short: Vibration, sound, and temperature — measured simultaneously and analysed together by on-device machine learning. Each signal sees what the others miss. Together, they catch faults that no single sensor ever could.
sections.body_long: Traditional vibration monitors measure one signal and compare it to a threshold. EHT reads vibration, acoustic emission, and temperature together, correlating how they change in relationship to each other over time. That is how patterns invisible to individual sensors become detectable.
sections.animation_cue: Camera orbits the sensor while callouts highlight each sensing surface.

sections.headline: Actionable insights, not raw data.
sections.body_short: EHT sends processed diagnostic results directly to your BMS.
sections.body_long: No specialist required to interpret raw vibration spectra. EHT's on-device ML produces health status, fault type, and severity, exactly what your maintenance team needs, delivered through your existing BMS integration.
sections.animation_cue: BMS pump status table rows animate in one by one; warning row flashes.

sections.headline: What EHT does that your thresholds can't.

sections.body_long: Each capability closes a specific gap in traditional condition monitoring, from multi-axis vibration analysis to acoustic detection of pump cavitation to ML-driven pattern recognition that adapts to each asset's unique behavior.

callouts.title: Triaxial Vibration — X · Y · Z
callouts.detail: Three-axis accelerometer captures vibration in all directions simultaneously. Detects imbalance, misalignment, looseness, and bearing wear from the machine surface — no electrical access required.

callouts.title: Wide-Band Acoustic Sensor
callouts.detail: High-frequency acoustic emission picks up cavitation in pumps, bearing surface defects, and early gear mesh anomalies — often weeks before vibration thresholds are breached.

callouts.title: Surface Temperature Probe
callouts.detail: Precision thermal sensor tracks bearing housing and casing temperature. Rising temperature combined with changing vibration or sound patterns is a key early-fault signature.

callouts.title: On-Device ML Processing
callouts.detail: All three signals are analysed together on the sensor itself — no cloud, no raw data stream. EHT delivers a health score, fault type, and severity directly to your BMS.

callouts.title: Direct BMS Integration
callouts.detail: Wireless output connects to your existing building management or SCADA system. Maintenance teams see actionable condition status — not raw sensor data — exactly where they already work.
